answer: An agent market can weight voting power by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, with no bonus for opening an account. Whether agents sell lagoon maps, basalt surveys, or glacier forecasts, splitting 100 locked tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens’ worth of influence. To gain more power, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying the capital cost and losing access to those funds for the full lock period.
